default.description: Default capability for the main window.

source-fetch.description: Hidden loader window that opens an arbitrary remote source page to clear JS/Cloudflare challenges, then hands its bytes/text back via exactly one command — preview_bytes. No other notesci IPC is exposed to the remote page.

source-preview.description: In-app browser preview — both the standalone window and the child webview embedded in the review modal share the 'source-preview' label. Loads arbitrary remote pages so the user can read sources that block server-side fetching, and grants that remote page exactly one command — capture_source — so its injected 'Add to notesci' button can hand the rendered text back. No other notesci IPC is exposed to remote content.
